shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && git ls-files && cat AGENTS.md

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 3 -i 'date-components|date-utils|calendar' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -20; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@3 version 2>&1 | tail -3
for v in 3 4; do npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v version peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -4; done
npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -5 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker; grep version node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; rg -n -i -C 4 'setup|styles|import' README.md | head -60; ls dist/docs
ls -R dist/docs/components | head -30; f=$(find dist/docs/components -iname '*.md' -path '*Calendar*' | grep -v -i range | head -3); echo $f; for x in $f; do wc -l $x; done

f=$(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist -name 'Calendar.d.ts' | head -2); echo $f; cat $f | head -40; rg -n 'onUpdate|selectionMode' $(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist -path '*Calendar*' -name '*.d.ts' | grep -v Range) | head; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Text Flex | head; rg -n 'format\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist/*/typings/dateTime.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3 || rg -rn 'format\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist --include '*.d.ts' | head -3

sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts; rg -n 'format' $(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist -name '*.d.ts' | grep -i typ | head -5) | head -5; rg -n 'spacing|gap' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -5; rg -n 'view\?|type CardView|theme\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head

sed -n 40,70p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils; rg -n '    format\(|export declare function dateTime\b|export declare const dateTime\b' -g '*.d.ts' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils | head -5; rg -n 'ContainerCardView =' -g '*.d.ts' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card
